message: I reviewed the diagram and found no architecture defects to fix: every component uses its typed implementation, all six connections have the right integration, the existing uploader keeps its read/write access, and Sydney is still only a candidate region. None of the three findings can be cleared by changing the diagram, so all three remain open. First, someone needs to run provider-schema validation (terraform init and validate) against this exact export. Second, the application needs acceptance evidence from a sandbox run: a word count is saved, a duplicate delivery doesn't overwrite it, a failure is retried, a poison message reaches the dead-letter queue and raises an alarm, access is denied where it should be, and cleanup works. Third, we need to review the requirements against the generated settings, including identity, limits, region, cost and cleanup. Until then, identity, region support, quotas, costs and runtime behaviour are all unverified. To review the requirements, we first need one piece of information: is there an existing SNS topic for dead-letter alarms, and who should receive those alerts?

requirementDrafts.rationale: Without this evidence, a generated Terraform export could look complete but behave incorrectly or leave resources behind.
requirementDrafts.basis: Validation findings application-not-qualified, provider-schema-unverified and requirements-review-unverified.
requirementDrafts.statement: Proposed: before this design is called qualified, the exact export has schema validation plus sandbox evidence for a successful count, safe duplicate delivery, retry, dead-letter routing with an alarm, denied access and cleanup.
